notes: 30 scenes: the benchmark's first ten public_2601 scenes plus twenty more drawn from the same suite (seed 20260922, stratified by speed and turn). One rollout per scene, same referee config as the ten-scene row. Retrained checkpoint, not the released one: the trajectory generator retrained on Physical AI AV train, behind the native AlpaSim driver at 0.1.7 (tools/models/drivejepa/alpasim_driver). The driver's log names the weights by label, not by hash, so this row cannot prove which file drove. Adapted, not zero-shot. See docs/models/drivejepa.md.
